about_the_game:
If you could change a friend's memories of a tragic event by sacrificing their most cherished objects, how far would you go ?

France, 2091. Neuropsychology, demonology and engineering found common ground around the greatest creation of the century : the Memory Palace. A mental place that anyone can build when their case seems beyond saving to everybody but a very few selected people called Healers. 

You are the most renowned Healer of the country, and a friend asked for your help to fight her Inner Demon. But the costs may be way higher that you are willing to pay...

Confront painful memories through deeply meaningful minigames, recall events of a tragic accident to learn about the truth, and get closer to your friend. You will need as much strength as you can to fight the Inner Demon inhabiting her  Memory Palace once and for all. 

FEATURES

  • Meaningful minigames telling their part of the story.

  • Intuitive movement avoiding South/North/East/West design.

  • A character with whom you can deepen your relationship.

  • Important choices where there is no good or wrong answers.

content_descriptors.notes: The game talks about trauma and death through dialogue, description and game mechanics
